_doc: Experiment definitions. Each entry resolves to odometry_train.py arguments: --config configs/odometry.json, --data <data>, then 'args'. Shared blocks are referenced by name in 'use'. Decision gates are declared before results exist.

budget.note: 12 epochs x 244 windows (batch 1, accumulation 2). Identical for every D run regardless of dataset size.

selection_rule: Checkpoint = epoch with the lowest selection_score (mean of nominal and 5 s moving-start unaligned ATE on the fixed development roster) evaluated on EMA weights. Last checkpoint retained for diagnostics.

refinement_screen.control: Frozen B-D0-ssm-x3 best checkpoint for each paired seed
refinement_screen.data: teacher-full train only for fitting; frozen head features computed by causal continuous replay. Development selects the best epoch; no reserved or confirmation test data.
refinement_screen.gate: K=3 must lower paired three-seed mean dev ATE by at least 10% versus frozen K=0, regress ordinary dev by at most 5%, and improve on the matched K=1 arm. Report the first 30 s on proxy-val and campaign-dev (ProcTHOR/HSSD separately) as independent checks for all arms. Correlation is a separate implementation path with no accuracy claim in this screen.

gates.screen_improvement: At least 10% lower equal-flight mean unaligned development ATE than the paired control (engineering gate, not statistical significance).
gates.ordinary_motion_guardrail: No more than 5% regression on ordinary-motion (benchmark-regime, non-yaw) development flights.
gates.advance: Runs passing both gates advance to three paired seeds (217, 218, 219).
gates.domain_followup: If D1/D2 fail the native-development gate but improve on the proxy-validation holdout, run D1n/D2n to separate motion coverage from reduced native exposure (21.3% in D0 vs 4.4% in D1/D2).
gates.architecture_block: T-series runs use D0 data and recipe; each is compared scene-paired to D0-ssm (seed 217) with the same screen (>=10% lower dev mean unaligned ATE), the ordinary-motion guardrail, and the 30 s proxy-validation criterion as a second, independent check. If the D-series selects expanded data, the T-series is rerun on it instead.
gates.attitude_block: A-D0-ssm-x3 versus B-D0-ssm-x3 at 36 epochs with seeds 217/218/219. Require at least 10% lower mean development unaligned ATE and at most 5% ordinary-development regression. Check proxy validation at 30 s and campaign development at 30 s and full length, separately for ProcTHOR and HSSD. The campaign attitude oracle is a diagnostic and uses dev rotations only.
gates.attitude_calibration_probe: After the initial yaw/tilt oracle, compare the original rolling-calibration attitude with raw gyro integration without calibration, with the same true body velocities on campaign development only. Report 30 s and full unaligned ATE to determine whether the rolling bias estimate is a major source of residual drift. This diagnostic does not select a model.
gates.attitude_hybrid_block: Run only after the parallax-aware visual correction passes its predeclared dev gate and the three A-D0-ssm-x3 runs finish. Hold each seed's frozen B-D0 velocities fixed and compare raw, visual-only, learned-only, and hybrid attitudes. Use learned increments between visual decisions. At an accepted visual update use the visual relative rotation over that interval, attached to the earlier hybrid anchor, so the endpoint counts the interval's bias correction once. Require 10% lower dev mean unaligned ATE than the better standalone attitude and at most 5% regression versus either standalone attitude on ordinary, static-start, and moving-start dev. Report campaign-dev 30 s by catalog and start. Reserved test remains unscored.
gates.native_campaign_block: N1-ssm-x3 vs B-D0-ssm-x3, three seeds each, decided on three-seed means: screen >=10% lower development mean unaligned ATE and the ordinary-motion guardrail; independent checks are the 30 s proxy-validation criterion and campaign-dev (new flights in ProcTHOR 166-171 and in 15 never-used HSSD Val43 houses, reported separately). The reserved campaign test split (ProcTHOR 162-165/172-175, 28 HSSD Val43 houses) stays unscored.
gates.native_start_coverage_block: N2-early-native-x3 vs N2-ssm-x3 with seeds 217/218/219, the same manifest, 36 epochs, 244 windows/epoch, 4392 optimizer updates and otherwise matched training recipe. In feasible native-campaign backward/lateral strata, target at least 25% of draws at an eligible start within the first second of the same 0 s or 5 s crop; require at least 12 eligible training scenes for each targeted kind/catalog/crop stratum. Keep N2's per-epoch draw kinds, domain, catalog, crop and all untargeted windows; verify feasibility by deterministic CPU replay before training. Require >=10% lower three-seed dev mean unaligned ATE and <=5% regression on ordinary dev and on each dev start group. Report dev static and 5 s moving starts, 30 s proxy-val, and campaign-dev 30 s and full ATE for ProcTHOR and HSSD separately with static/moving and backward/lateral subdivisions. Reserved test stays unscored. A later generated-data arm may fill the raw early-lateral strata only after a label-only, train-scene pilot, using the same total window and update budgets.
gates.visual_attitude_block: Freeze the B-D0 best checkpoints for seeds 217/218/219 and replay their exact same body-frame velocities through baseline and causal visual-corrected attitude. Use 0.5 s non-overlapping image pairs; require spatially spread forward/backward LK tracks, gate the direct rotation fit to low residual flow, and use a translation-aware essential-matrix fit only with adequate cheirality, support, and estimated parallax. Apply 0.35 gain and reject corrections over 0.12 rad. Primary dev gate: >=10% lower three-seed mean unaligned ATE and <=5% regression on ordinary flights and each start group. Report nominal/static and 5 s moving starts separately; check campaign-dev 30 s by catalog and start. Only passing candidates advance to hybrid on the learned-attitude rotations, holding that candidate's velocities fixed between hybrid arms, and to C/C++ WebAssembly peak fuel measurement. No reserved-test replay.
gates.long_budget_block: Compare 72 epochs against the validated 36-epoch B-speed-compiled-x3 control on seeds 217/218/219, holding D0 data, optimizer, batch, sampler, EMA and initial LR fixed, with the cosine schedule stretched to each budget. Use equal-flight mean unaligned dev ATE and the <=5% ordinary-motion guardrail. Promote to 144 epochs only if the three-seed dev mean falls at least 10% and 30 s proxy ATE does not regress. Report start splits and both campaign catalogs at 30 s and full duration. Reserved test unscored.
gates.retrain_attitude_block: Declared 2026-11-19 before any training or evaluation of these arms (branch odometry/retrain-attitude). Question: does the velocity network improve when its INPUTS (gyro-derotated image history, bias-corrected gyro and sub-packet features, bias/activated features, and the row attitude it integrates through) use a better causal attitude, rather than only integrating frozen velocities through it (attitude_bias.py)? Data: N2 (n2-campaign-tiers, 1,770 train + 14 dev records), because the compiled recipe trains a fixed 244 windows/epoch so N2 costs the same GPU time as D0 and N2 is the strongest model family; input shards are re-derived from the existing rolling shards by input_attitude.py (no raw for proxy parents on this machine; identity check reproduces rolling shards; derived static08 attitude matches attitude_bias static08 on raw campaign dev: 15.31 vs 15.31 deg mean error). Arms, all with the same compiled recipe (B-speed-compiled-x3 options + N2's balanced sampler, 36 epochs, 244 windows/epoch), seeds 217/218/219: RA-N2-control-x3 (original rolling shards), RA-N2-static08-x3 (static08 input attitude), RA-N2-kfgrid-x3 (kf_grid_native: ungated kf_grid at native resolution where raw exists = all 1,184 campaign train records, campaign dev, public; kf_grid at 128x96 for proxy/native parents, D0 dev and proxy-val, which validation showed is weaker: 12.0 vs 6.1 deg public). Each arm's own derived eval shards are used for dev, proxy-val (first 30 s) and campaign-dev (30 s and full); public (10 flights) via --set records. Primary question metric: three-seed mean unaligned ATE on campaign-dev full with every model integrated through the SAME native ungated kf_grid attitude (attitude_bias.py arm kf_grid), arm vs control; an input change 'helps' if >=5% lower with ordinary-motion and both start groups not >5% worse; public with kf_grid integration is a secondary diagnostic. Also reported: each model integrated through its own row attitude (deployable as-is), dev, proxy-val 30 s, campaign 30 s, per seed, ProcTHOR/HSSD, static/moving, ordinary/backward-lateral, velocity metrics. Null results are reported as such.
gates.throughput_block: D0 timing pilots (seed 217) use the existing 244 windows and same model, comparing median steady-state epoch (train + development replay), timings per component, and peak GPU memory. Timing-pilot accuracy is diagnostic. The fastest successful steady-state pilot among prefix, compiled, and batch4 advances to its matching B-speed trial. The full 36-epoch candidate is compared at equal scored frame exposure against B-D0-ssm-x3, over seeds 217/218/219, with a development ATE tolerance of +5%, ordinary-motion guardrail, and proxy-val 30 s as independent check. Target is 10x per epoch-equivalent. Report GPU count and separate initialization/compile time.
gates.hyperparameter_block: Use the hp_search.py D0-ssm trial roster. The base and three LR trials had partial checkpoints when this gate was written. Screen all trials at 12 epochs using paired seeds 217/218; rank by equal-seed mean of best development selection scores, and advance up to two non-base trials that beat the paired base. Run finalists from scratch for 36 epochs on seeds 217/218/219. Compare the three-seed full-replay means against B-D0-ssm-x3 using the 10% dev improvement screen, 5% ordinary-motion guardrail, and 30 s proxy-validation check.
gates.hyperparameter_fast_transfer: Before scheduling any fast HP runs, require the predeclared B-speed-compiled-x3 full-replay tolerance on both dev and ordinary dev (+5% at most against B-D0 over three seeds), inspect proxy-val 30 s, and verify fast trial overrides and local compiler isolation. Finish all eight original hp1 jobs. If transfer passes and the remaining slow sweep has not started, restart the same 12-epoch roster in a separate HP tag with every trial including base using the B-speed-compiled-x3 recipe. Promote based only on that tag. At 36 epochs replay against both three-seed controls (B-speed-compiled-x3 and B-D0-ssm-x3); require the original hyperparameter gate against B-D0. If transfer fails or is unsafe, finish the existing hp1 plan.
gates.attitude_fast_block: A-speed-compiled-x3 versus B-speed-compiled-x3, paired at seeds 217/218/219 with the same 36 epochs, 244 windows per epoch, and compiled recipe. Require at least 10% lower mean development unaligned ATE, at most 5% regression on ordinary dev, and improvement on proxy-validation 30 s. Report static and moving crops separately, and campaign development at 30 s and full length for ProcTHOR and HSSD separately. Report training throughput and cold compile time separately. Reserved test remains unscored.
gates.openvins_stationary: Native upstream OpenVINS 6948812, one calibrated monocular camera, dynamic initialization enabled, ZUPT off vs on with all input crops and other options paired. Replay exactly the existing campaign-dev 30 s records (0 s and 5 s crops of all 60 parents) and measure full-crop unaligned ATE separately for static and moving starts, retaining initialization failures. To qualify for a WASM feasibility/fuel follow-up, at least one arm must lower equal-flight mean ATE by 10% against the three-seed B-D0-ssm-x3 campaign-dev 30 s mean and regress ordinary flights by no more than 5%. Keep reserved tests unscored.
gates.proxy_validation_criterion: Declared 2026-11-18 ~15:30, before any D1/D2 result: the proxy-validation holdout is scored on each replay's first 30 s (benchmark flight length; odometry_eval.py --set proxy-val --max-seconds 30), scene-paired against the control. The full 90 s score is a long-horizon diagnostic only: there even true velocity through our attitude scores 1.04 m, so it mostly measures attitude drift.

tune.note: CPU only. Use native-campaign training records, both 0 s and 5 s crops. Sample four distinct parents from each catalog x regime group after sorting, using a fixed RNG. Use a pooled per-axis RMS velocity residual from all tuning frames and all three frozen best checkpoints as the fixed measurement standard deviation (floor 0.01 m/s). Select the grid member with lowest equal-replay ATE averaged over the three seeds, breaking ties in grid order. Use fixed gyro attitude, gravity prior sigma 0.5 m/s², accelerometer bias walk 0.02 m/s²/sqrt(s) when enabled, and disable learned variance. Freeze before reading development predictions.

B-D0-fixed-ekf.gate: Advance to uncertainty learning only on at least 10% lower three-seed mean full dev ATE and no more than 5% ordinary-dev regression. Require no more than 5% regression on proxy-val 30 s or either campaign-dev 30 s catalog before recommending adoption. All four comparisons use the frozen training-selected setting against the same checkpoint predictions integrated directly. Reserved test and confirmation are excluded.

datasets.teacher-full: D0 restricted control: the exact old teacher roster (48 proxy base + 12 native + 1 native yaw parents, crops 0/5 s), development roster of 7 native parents.
datasets.d1-expanded-tiers: D1/D2: all 280 eligible proxy training parents (base/mid/agile) + the same 13 native training parents; identical development roster.
datasets.d1-expanded-tiers-labeled: Same shards and splits as d1-expanded-tiers, with domain/tier labels from the audited ledger (needed for domain_share).

RA-N2-control-x3.note: Matched control: compiled recipe on the original N2 rolling-policy shards (hard links). Seeds 217/218/219; retrain_attitude_block.

RA-N2-static08-x3.note: N2 shards re-derived with static08 input attitude (input_attitude.py). Seeds 217/218/219; retrain_attitude_block.

RA-N2-kfgrid-x3.note: N2 shards re-derived with kf_grid_native input attitude (input_attitude.py). Seeds 217/218/219; retrain_attitude_block.

P-speed-control.note: GPU timing control, original B-D0 recipe, seed 217.

P-speed-parallel.note: Matched effective batch timing pilot for chunked parallel SSM, batched replay, preloading, TF32 and BF16; seed 217.

P-speed-prefix.note: Same number of windows per optimizer update as control. Fused optimizer, reduced host synchronization, channels-last CNN, prefix scan and batched replay.

P-speed-compiled.note: Same as P-speed-prefix, plus torch.compile on the local correlation operator. Include cold compile time separately.

B-speed-prefix-x3.note: 36 epochs and 244 windows per epoch. Candidate for the throughput block; seeds 217/218/219.

B-speed-compiled-x3.note: 36 epochs and 244 windows per epoch. Candidate for the throughput block; seeds 217/218/219.

A-speed-compiled-x3.note: Causal gyro-bias correction transferred to the validated compiled throughput recipe. The matching B-speed-compiled-x3 control has identical settings with the correction head disabled.

P-speed-batch4.note: Larger-batch saturation probe. Equal exposure, batch 4 versus batch 2. LR multiplied by sqrt(2), EMA per-step decay squared to preserve smoothing in seen windows.

B-speed-batch4-x3.note: 36 epochs at the batch-4 pilot recipe. Equal scored exposure with fewer updates; seeds 217/218/219.

P-speed-ddp.note: Strong-scaling pilot for 1/2/4 H100s. Split each global batch of four across ranks, keeping seed, frames, 61 updates per epoch and LR fixed. Compare steady-state train time, development replay time and GPU-hours separately.

D1n-ssm.note: Follow-up (declared 09:40 before D results): expanded tiers with native share pinned to D0's 21.3%, startup/uniform windows only.

D2n-ssm.note: Follow-up: balanced motion mixture plus native share pinned to 21.3%.

T-ssm4.note: Architecture block (declared 2026-11-18 before D1/D2 results; control D0-ssm, same data/recipe/budget): 4-layer SSM, 1.432M params.

T-grussm.note: Hybrid: 1 residual GRU then 1 SSM block, 1.313M.

T-ssm-w240.note: 12 s scored context (240 frames + 32 burn-in), 66 windows/epoch so scored frames match the budget within 1.4% (66x240=15,840 vs 244x64=15,616 per epoch; the original sampler needs an even count, so the first launch with 65 crashed). Optimizer updates are fewer; that is the cost of longer context at equal data exposure.

B-D0-ssm-x3.note: Budget follow-up (declared 2026-11-18 ~19:00 after D results, before running): D0 at 3x optimizer updates (4,392). D0 was still improving steeply at epoch 12 and D1/D2 saw each parent ~5x less often, so equal-budget results may reflect undertraining of the larger dataset.

A-D0-ssm-x3.note: Predeclared before attitude results: causal SSM gyro-bias residual, initialized to zero and learned through the camera displacement loss. Only the attitude used to integrate velocity is corrected.

B-D2-ssm-x3.note: Budget follow-up: D2 at 3x updates. Gate: same screen and guardrail against B-D0-ssm-x3 (equal budget), plus the 30 s proxy-validation criterion.

P-imu-blind.note: Probe (plan step 6): D0-ssm with direct IMU features zeroed (frame interval kept). Measures what the network takes from the IMU beyond derotation; compare with D0-ssm and gru-blind (images blanked).

B-D2n-ssm-x3.note: Domain follow-up triggered by the predeclared rule (2026-11-18 ~21:40): B-D2-ssm-x3 failed the native dev gate (3-seed mean 1.250 vs 1.095) but improved the 30 s proxy-validation holdout (1.128 vs 1.276, non-overlapping seed ranges). D2's balanced mixture with native share pinned to D0's 21.3%, 3x budget, seeds 217/218/219.

N2-ssm-x3.note: Declared 2026-11-18 ~22:00 before composing its data: expanded proxy tiers (d1-expanded-tiers-labeled) plus the 592 campaign train parents, D2's balanced motion mixture, 3x budget, seeds 217/218/219. Compared with N1-ssm-x3 and B-D0-ssm-x3 under the native-campaign block's gates.

N2-early-native-x3.note: Matched N2 data-coverage comparison predeclared in native_start_coverage_block; CPU roster feasibility before GPU launch.

N1-ssm-x3.note: Native campaign (declared 2026-11-18 ~20:30, before the data were composed): teacher-full-labeled plus the campaign's train flights (ProcTHOR 0-9/46-149/180-199 + HSSD Train125, 30-90 s, 25% independent yaw). Control B-D0-ssm-x3 at the same 4,392 updates. Seeds 217/218/219 for both arms.

U-D0-ssm.note: EKF fusion workstream: D0-ssm plus a per-axis velocity log-variance head (Gaussian NLL on velocity, detached mean, weight 0.02). 12-epoch screen; compared with D0-ssm (velocity unchanged?) and through odometry_eval.py --ekf.

U-D0-ssm-x3.note: EKF fusion workstream: U-D0-ssm at the B-D0-ssm-x3 budget (4,392 updates), seeds 217/218/219; control B-D0-ssm-x3.

arms: none: integrate raw gyro, zero bias
first: freeze bias at first accepted rolling window
frozen_bias_ablation.dataset: campaign-dev only, 120 existing crop replays, no reserved tests
frozen_bias_ablation.primary: mean unaligned ATE at 30 seconds and full; report 60-second prefixes only where available
frozen_bias_ablation.exploratory_screen: at least 10% lower mean at 30s and full, ordinary/catalog/historical start groups no more than 5% regression; original dev and proxy gates unchanged and required before qualification
frozen_bias_ablation.mechanism: Remove later false-stationary gyro bias updates; differs from failed visual rotation fit and EKF. Earlier raw gyro oracle is motivation, frozen predicted velocity is new measured intervention. No new learned weights.
frozen_bias_ablation.interaction: Freeze original image derotation and IMU model inputs for isolation; complete system must later regenerate both with new orientation before deployment. No artifact qualifies based solely on frozen-velocity result.
frozen_bias_ablation.fuel: No whole guest implementation unless screen passes; no kernel extrapolation
frozen_bias_ablation.parity: raw reconstruction control must match prepared R <=1e-6; replay prefix must equal corresponding full prefix
